11950.d: The Glacor Front is the second of four fronts of the Elder God Wars Dungeon, released on 31 August 2021.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Glacor Front is located in the southern section of Senntisten, which can be accessed by ancient door north of the Archaeology Guild (which can be quickly teleported to with Archaeology journal) and directly east of Tolna's rift. After entering Senntisten the player needs to access the cathedral to the south of the entrance and then leave through southern cathedral door. Passing through the western door for the first time triggers a cutscene.
• The Master archaeologist's outfit will teleport to near the cathedral.
• Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door.
• Using a Gnome glider to Lemanto Andra (3) leaves the player very close to ancient door.
• The Pontifex shadow ring, awarded by City of Senntisten quest, can teleport the player directly to the cathedral.
• The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 Archaeology Archaeology or access to those items.
• The Boss portal in War's Retreat (requiring at least one kill of Arch-Glacor) or boss portal in Max Guild (doesn't require a kill) can be attuned to teleport the player to the Aqueduct Portal, where the boss can be accessed, a short distance to the south of Slayer area.

11980.d: Globin Village is a settlement located within Fenmoor on the island Havenhythe.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Bogolin telepearl
• Home teleport to Wendlewick and take a canoe to either:
• Amberfell 4, then head south-east through Moonsylvar Wood.
• Heathervein 5, traverse the River crossing (63 Agility) and Slippery stone (73 Agility), run south.
• Linbog Village 6, head south-east of Fenmoor.
• Stonevein amulet teleport to the Fox mural (requires initial restoration).
• Fairy ring code DIQ and head south-west (must first be repaired with 5 bogwart mushrooms and requires 79 Agility).
• Without access to the canoe stations or fairy ring network:
• # Home teleport to Wendlewick.
• # Head east to Amberfell using the bridge south of Ivar, King of Bones.
• # Climb over the barricade east of Amberfell (next to Ash).
• # Head south-east past Berylbrook, through Moonsylvar Wood.
• # Walk east, then south-east of Fenmoor.
